response.sql: WITH country_avg_wins AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId GROUP BY c.country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM country_avg_wins), above_overall AS (SELECT caw.country, caw.avg_wins FROM country_avg_wins caw CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE caw.avg_wins > oa.overall_avg), above_avg_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as above_avg_group_avg FROM above_overall), final_countries AS (SELECT ao.country, ao.avg_wins FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_avg aaga WHERE ao.avg_wins > aaga.above_avg_group_avg) SELECT AVG(fc.avg_wins) as mean_of_final_countries, AVG(fc.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg) as mean_exceed_overall, AVG(fc.avg_wins - aaga.above_avg_group_avg) as mean_exceed_above_avg FROM final_countries fc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa CROSS JOIN above_avg_group_avg aaga
